navDescriptor: A monthly scan of every client site, a report you resell.

seo.title: Site care agents for agencies | Superflow
seo.description: Agents scan every client site on a schedule for broken links, expired offers, drifted brand, and dead forms. A report goes to you. Resell it under your own name.

hero.h1: Every client site, scanned monthly, before the client notices.
hero.sub: Agents scan every page on a schedule. Broken links, expired offers, drifted brand, dead forms. Findings post as comments and a report goes to you. Resell it under your own name.
hero.clientLine: The client gets the monthly report under your name and taps Approve on the fixes from their phone.

pack.name: Site Care Pack
pack.intro: Eight agents for the monthly scan. They run on every page of every client site on the schedule you set.

agents.name: Broken Links
agents.checks: Follows every link on every page and flags the ones that fail.

agents.name: Stale Dates
agents.checks: Finds years, dates and copyright lines that are out of date.

agents.name: Offer Expiry
agents.checks: Finds any special, promo, or discount with a past end date.
agents.finding: Homepage banner: 'Spring sale, ends May 31.' Today is Sept 3.

agents.name: Form Health
agents.checks: Checks each form submits and reaches a thank-you state.
agents.finding: Contact form on /about submits but never reaches the thank-you page.

agents.name: Tracking Check
agents.checks: Confirms analytics and tag manager fire on every page.
agents.finding: GA4 fires on every page except the thank-you page. Conversions won't count.

agents.name: Palette Guard
agents.checks: Checks every color on the page against the brand guide.
agents.finding: Primary button uses #2F80ED. The brand guide allows #1E5BB8.

agents.name: Meta Titles
agents.checks: Checks every page has a unique, specific title.

agents.name: Contrast
agents.checks: Checks text contrast meets WCAG AA.
agents.finding: Body text is 3.1:1 against the background. AA needs 4.5:1.

buildYourOwn.input: Flag any page that hasn't changed in 12 months.
buildYourOwn.finding: 9 blog posts haven't changed since 2024. Consider refreshing or removing.

agentsCheck: No link on any site is broken.
No offer or date is out of date.
Colors and fonts still match the guide.
Every form still reaches its thank-you page.
youDecide: Which findings go in the client report.
What to charge for the care plan.
When a site needs a refresh, not a fix.
Which fixes to ship this month.

resell.heading: Resell it.
lines: You set the retail price for the care plan.
The report and the review toolbar carry your logo, not ours.
Superflow bills you per scan. Your client never sees an invoice from us.

faq.q: How often can the scan run?
faq.a: Weekly or monthly, per site. You can also run one by hand before a client call.
A rescan checks only the pages that changed, so it costs a fraction of a full scan at any site size. The pricing page has the numbers.

faq.q: Can the report carry our branding?
faq.a: Yes. Upload your logo once. The monthly report, the review toolbar, and the admin portal your client sees all carry it.
